brief: Goldman's consumer desk update, 3 September 2026, 7:45am ET. Futures are mixed into the holiday weekend with SPX +5bps, NDX -10bps and RTY -13bps after a green session, on little overnight news. Yields stabilized, attributed to softer ADP private payrolls and Williams comments, and the market now prices a 60% chance of a hike at the September meeting, with Waller this morning, NFP tomorrow, CPI 9/11 and BoJ 9/18 as the next catalysts. The consumer earnings moves are framed against the bar each name carried: VSXY, up 57% YTD at a sector-high 18x P/E, was expected to beat and raise, missed topline at $1.61B, and fell 15%. FIVE beat and guided 3Q well above consensus, so it rose. PVH beat on margin but reaffirmed FY and guided 3Q below consensus, so upside is not flowing through. CPB cut its dividend 35% and guided 2027 below. WOOF's profit beat plus 22% short interest drove short covering. GS Prime August: gross leverage rose for the first time in three months, Consumer Discretionary was net bought, defensives net sold a fifth straight month.
